_comment: Family history and tree. Hand-edit freely. 'people' entries render newest-to-oldest by the 'sort' field if present, otherwise in the order written. Photos go in media/_history/ (the leading underscore keeps build.py from filing them into a girl's gallery).

tree.label: The McConnell tree on Ancestry
tree.note: Opens Ancestry. You'll need to be signed in, and the tree's owner has to have invited you or made the tree public — otherwise Ancestry shows a private-tree notice instead. Living family members stay hidden to anyone not invited.
